archetypes.name: dyn-launcher-kv
archetypes.rationale: Launcher stdout now carries failure classification consumed by Step 7a.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Claude subprocess launcher classification path and the code-flow parser together. Verify that auth sidecars are classified before stdout emission, that success and legacy failure outputs stay backward-compatible, and that the Step 7a reason only includes sanitized stable labels. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
